query: INSERT INTO model_lifecycle_notices (project_id, provider, model_id, stage, shutdown_on, sent_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6) ON CONFLICT (project_id, provider, model_id, stage) DO UPDATE SET shutdown_on = EXCLUDED.shutdown_on, sent_at = EXCLUDED.sent_at WHERE model_lifecycle_notices.shutdown_on IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.shutdown_on RETURNING project_id
